edits.name: Hexpyre
edits.change: Substantially REDESIGN this floating fire-caster machine into an original new chassis. Palette swap its entire chassis AND arms to black/anthracite with graphite, cool grey edge highlights, no gold metal. Keep the two articulated raised fire-casting arms and orange/gold flames. REMOVE EVERY armor spike and horn. REMOVE the central green eye and the entire horizontal eye slit: blank armored facial area, no central eye, no sensor slit. Replace the old wide semicircular trapezoid shell with a compact vertical hovering furnace body, a faceted inverted teardrop breastplate, stacked offset cooling fins, inset ember-lit rib vents and rounded ball-joint shoulder sockets. Clear NEW silhouette and panel layout, no maze camouflage pattern. Two slim skeletal-mechanical arms with visible elbow and shoulder swivel joints and multi-finger casting hands. Modular design: separate visibly connected torso, two upper arms, two forearms/casting hands; their mechanical pivot joints must make physical sense. One assembled whole original drone only, no exploded layout in THIS image. Maintain rich arcade pixel-art look. Make all-black armor readable and avoid losing its outline.

edits.name: Rifle Locust
edits.change: Regenerate as a substantially redesigned original mutated rifle drone. Remove ALL four tall pointed claw/scythe/blade booms completely. NO claws, NO long sharp antennae, NO spear-like wing blades, no pointed insect forelimbs. Keep olive and deep green metal armor, red organic cable tendons and two practical underslung rifle cannons. Replace the old split-diamond central shell with a broad compact beveled oval hover chassis with offset industrial armor panels, three small red rectangular sensor lamps high on the chest and a lower exposed ribbed red biological reactor. Give it two short rounded rectangular lateral engine nacelles, blunt winglets and two independently mounted rifle turrets with round pivots. The entire outline is a new blunt, powerful hovering gunship shape, far removed from the reference's tall insect blades. Rich readable arcade pixel art with black outlines and worn metallic highlights. One whole assembled drone only.

edits.name: Hellhugger
edits.change: Develop this selected creature into a modular lightweight kamikaze claw attacker. Preserve its charcoal metal, restrained red armor accents, ivory paired talon blades, brown sinewy joint cables and green energy joints, with a red exposed central core. Refine into a centered 3/4 overhead front view with a small lightly armored hovering core-body and FOUR separately articulated claw limb modules joined at clearly visible round swivel sockets. Two long front striking claws and two shorter rear stabilizer claws. Show the paired talons slightly open, limbs swept back ready to snap forward in a lightning-fast pounce. Compact thin chassis, powerful small rear thruster pod, fragile exposed core so it reads easy to kill rather than a tank. No added guns, no bulky shield, no humongous HP-boss proportions. One assembled enemy only in this concept image, no duplicated parts. Consistent practical attachment joints so separate modular limb sprites can follow.
